records.title: ShareBERT: Embeddings Are Capable of Learning Hidden Layers
records.reason: ShareBERT constructs encoder transformations by sharing embedding parameters with hidden layers, with embedding factorization/virtual embeddings variants. AAAI full text reports GLUE results: ShareBERT Small uses 5.0M parameters (21.9x fewer) and reaches 95.5% of BERT Base average score; Base/Large trade parameter count for accuracy. It also evaluates translation and image captioning. This is model-size compression for encoder PLMs, but not autoregressive LLM inference/serving; retained as borderline adjacent compression evidence.

records.title: Text Diffusion with Reinforced Conditioning
records.reason: Improves text diffusion generation quality/control, not inference resource use or deployment efficiency.

records.title: How to Prune Your Language Model: Recovering Accuracy on the "Sparsity May Cry" Benchmark
records.reason: The paper re-examines BERT/RoBERTa pruning on SMC-Benchmark. On BERT encoder CPU inference with DeepSparse, pruning embeddings/classification head gave negligible speedups even at 98% sparsity and could damage accuracy; it recommends pruning the encoder. It also finds large initial pruning steps (50–70%) and adjusted schedules improve recovery at 90–97% sparsity. Scope is encoder classification/fine-tuning rather than generative LLM serving, so this is reasoned borderline.
